name: Paribus pETH redeem reentrancy
summary: The Paribus native-ETH market sent ether to the redeemer before the comptroller's collateral bookkeeping was updated, so the receive hook re-entered the protocol and borrowed against collateral that had already been withdrawn.

loss.notes: Imported from the seed inventory, which did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.

limitations: Target identity and code history were imported from the seed inventory without independent review.
One or more target block, transaction, ordering, or creator anchors remain unresolved.

sources.note: onchain review: pETH 0x375Ae76F0450293e50876D0e5bDC3022CAb23198 created 2023-03-27T15:21:40Z by 0x8acd5764d8edef0558dbdf40ae64c7ffb6531160, not the attack-tx sender 0x014abff04e5c441b2ceaa62d843bbc5ae49e5504. Compound-fork delegator, so NewImplementation(address,address) logs were queried in addition to EIP-1967: the only one is at the creation block 74259357, so the executing code was 14.8 days old. Loss ~86k per the DeFiHackLabs 2023 index entry for this PoC. Distinct from the 2025-01 Paribus row already in this file. Recheck of the deployment basis (DELEGATECALL audit): the victim is a Compound-fork PEtherDelegator keeping its implementation in plain storage slot 18; a binary search of eth_getStorageAt on slot 18 over [74259357, 79308098] finds 0x5b0ec471565e36e5a33c35b861dd752e16f3a8e7 unchanged from creation to the incident, the delegator runtime is byte-identical at both blocks, and that implementation contains no DELEGATECALL, so deployment is the right basis.

limitations: Classification and loss were imported from the seed inventory and await review.
The imported USD loss lacks structured valuation provenance.
